items.briefing:
Australian authorities have been contacting over 10,000 Australians caught up in an international cryptocurrency scam investigation through the National Anti-Scam Centre — if you receive contact from Scamwatch, take it seriously. Separately, a ransomware discussion from cybersecurity researcher Troy Hunt is a timely reminder that cyber extortion remains a real threat to organisations of all sizes, including training providers.

On the AI front, a local study found only 5% of staff use generative AI effectively, highlighting the importance of proper training before relying on these tools for work tasks. **Practical tip:** If you receive unexpected contact about a cryptocurrency investment or prize, verify it directly through the official Scamwatch website before responding.

featured.title: National Anti-Scam Centre contacts more than 10,000 Australians following international cryptocurrency scam investigation - Scamwatch
featured.quote: 10,000+ Australians targeted in crypto scam; direct threat to local population.
